messages:
Hannah P: Heads-up from onboarding: user copied the README 'curl' and hit two issues: 401 insufficient_scope and broken quoting on Windows.
Diego L: Can you paste the exact curl they ran?
Hannah P: From top-level quickstart:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-redwood-1\",\"input\":\"Hi\"}'
```
Maya R: Two problems: (1) scoped keys need inference.write for POSTs and our README doesn't mention that anywhere; (2) Windows users will copy single quotes and backslashes which fail in cmd.exe.
Eli B: Also spotted env var mismatch in sample-app: some samples read REDWOOD_KEY while docs use REDWOOD_API_KEY. That's a classic copy/paste footgun.
Diego L: Suggest small PR: (A) add a one-line "Auth scopes" note above the curl: "Ensure key includes inference.write for write requests"; (B) replace sample-app env var to use REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere; (C) add a Windows curl example showing proper quoting.
Maya R: For parity, the Go SDK readme doesn't mention retries at all. Node shows auth retry behavior; Go and Python are missing that guidance. Might add a single-line pointer: "For long-running jobs, configure automatic retries/refresh (see SDK retry docs)".
Docs Checker Bot: docs-ci: found inconsistent env var names across samples (REDWOOD_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_KEY). Linkcheck ok.
Hannah P: Minimal Windows example to include:
```
rem Windows CMD
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" ^
  -H "Authorization: Bearer %REDWOOD_API_KEY%" ^
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" ^
  -d "{\"model\":\"gpt-redwood-1\",\"input\":\"Hi\"}"
```
Eli B: I'll open PR with: scope note, env var fix across samples, Windows curl, and one-line changelog entry at top of README. Tagging @Maya R for SDK parity blurb and @Diego L for CI smoke test to verify sample-app env var.
Diego L: I'll add a tiny CI job in samples that runs quickstart on Linux and Windows runners to catch quoting/env var regressions.
Maya R: I'll add a one-liner into Go and Python quickstart sections pointing to SDK retry docs and include a short code example for Go showing a simple backoff.
Hannah P: Great. Leaving thread open until PR merged. :thumbsup:
